text: [image: CPR 2026 Midterm Voter Guide featuring Eileen Laubacher] Voter Guide Colorado Public Radio CPR’s 2026 Midterm Voter Guide Eileen Laubacher served in the U.S. Navy for 34 years before retiring with the rank of rear admiral. The first-time candidate said she never intended to run for office but felt called to serve “because we deserve a leader here in this district who understands this isn’t about you. It’s about service.” Read Voter Guide →

[image: Colorado Politics 2026 Midterm Voter Guide] Voter Guide Colorado Politics Colorado Politics 2026 Midterm Voter Guide Democrats have nominated Eileen Laubacher, a retired rear admiral who served as a senior military leader and National Security Council official. Laubacher is running on her national security experience, military service and calls for bipartisan problem-solving, arguing she can offer a different approach to representing the district in Washington. Read Voter Guide →

[image: Eileen Laubacher Coloradoan Candidate Q&A] Candidate Q&A Coloradoan Coloradoan Candidate Q&A Eileen Laubacher is a retired rear admiral who served in the United States Navy for 34 years. She never thought she’d run for office, but as she watched the chaos and dysfunction happening in Washington, she knew she had to do something. It’s time to send leaders to Congress who will treat this office and each other with respect, and work hard to solve our problems. Read Candidate Q&A →
